NC-NOISE-FP.expected: behavioral FP rate <= 0.15 on noise-only samples (no drift)

C2-VARIANCE.expected: >= 6 of 8 co-occurring conditions with behavioral_std > 0.05 AND structural_std > 0.05

B-STRUCTURAL-SIGNAL.expected: full-vector discrimination > 0.5 on auth-state changes (validated 0.8333 in EXP-RUNTIME-33902315583 and EXP-PRODUCT-35434772331 C1)

B-BEHAVIORAL-VARIANCE.expected: >= 6 of 8 co-occurring conditions with behavioral_std > 0.05 (graph baseline achieved 0.14-0.43)

B-ORTHO-GRAPHII.expected: 95% CI upper bound on |r| < 0.15 and TOST p_upper < 0.05 at delta=0.15 (graph baseline r=0.046, CI upper 0.135, p_upper=0.011)
B-ORTHO-GRAPHII.observed: r=-0.0258, CI upper 0.0639, TOST p_upper=5.6e-05 (all within the graph baseline envelope)

B-STATUS-ONLY.expected: status-code-only substrate collapses no_auth/expired/invalid onto 401 -> discrimination ~0.5

CTL-EXPIRED-COLLISION.observed: fingerprint 14553e10b9eddcb9 for both states; 3 unique fingerprints of 4 states

CTL-STATE-RESET.expected: set_drift(None) fully resets current_role/session_valid/drift/noise and restores DB rows between conditions
CTL-STATE-RESET.observed: all 8 co-occurring conditions proceeded with expected per-condition score ranges (PB ~0.45, SI ~0.85) and no cross-condition contamination

observations: Phase A: /api/data probed 10x per auth state on the stochastic Flask+SQLite server. Per-state fingerprints are internally stable (1 unique fingerprint per state); 3 unique fingerprints across 4 states because expired_token and invalid_token both produce 401 authentication_failed (same surface).

Phase B: 480 paired samples collected across 8 co-occurring conditions (2 auth drifts x 4 structural noises, 60 samples each). Each sample reads behavioral signal from /api/session/status and structural signal from /api/schema over real HTTP.
Phase C: 240 noise-only samples (4 noises x 60) with NO drift active. All behavioral scores observed at exactly 0.05 (admin-role baseline), i.e., 0 samples at/above the 0.25 detection threshold.

Phase D: 180 isolated-drift samples (3 drift types x 60). Observed score ranges: permission_boundary 0.32-0.545 (severity x propagated-permission count), session_invalidation 0.75-1.0 (graded status code 401/403/500), token_refresh fixed 0.65 (deterministic refresh surface).

Observed behavioral score ranges under co-occurring noise equal the ranges under isolation (PB mean 0.4525-0.46 with noise vs 0.455 isolated; SI mean 0.848-0.875 with noise vs 0.8633 isolated): noise does not shift the means or collapse the variance.

Within-condition behavioral variance: permission_boundary conditions std 0.0874-0.099; session_invalidation conditions std 0.0968-0.1039. All 8 conditions exceed the 0.05 variance gate. Structural variance (header/body cardinality) std 0.4034-0.4155 driven by TTL-cache freshness header presence and noise-dependent schema keys.
Pooled orthogonality over 480 pairs: Pearson r = -0.0258 (p=0.573, not significant), Fisher-z 95% CI [-0.115, 0.064], TOST at delta=0.15 passes on both tails (p_upper=5.6e-05, p_lower=3.1e-03).
Total real HTTP request cycles during measurement: ~1140 (40 phase-A probes + 960 paired phase-B/C probes + 180 phase-D probes + control-endpoint calls). No LLM calls; no network beyond localhost.
Runtime 106.3 s, single-threaded Werkzeug server (threaded=False) on 127.0.0.1:18950, seed=42 for the global Python RNG drawn before server start.
Frozen decision-rule outcome 'SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST' maps to canonical packet outcome SUPPORTS (all of C1-C4 pass at the frozen ceiling).
validity_notes: Measurements are bounded to the localhost Flask 3.1.3 + SQLite mock server (prereg measurement_validity #6, #7); they are not production-API measurements.

token_refresh isolated TP has behavioral_std=0.0 by design: the /api/session/status refresh surface is a fixed refreshed+new_token response (score 0.65, TP=1.0). The C2 TP test requires a rate >= 0.85, not variance; token_refresh is not part of the 8 co-occurring orthogonality conditions (frozen spec table is 2 drifts x 4 noises), so the orthogonality variance precondition is unaffected.

C1 discrimination is 0.8333, not 1.0, because expired_token and invalid_token deliberately share one 401 authentication_failed surface (replicating parent baselines B-STATUS-ONLY=0.5, B-BODY-ONLY=0.8333). The frozen gate is > 0.5 (PC-STRUCTURAL-DISCRIMINATION), not perfeCt separation.

permission_boundary behavioral_std (0.087-0.099) is below the graph-lane range (0.14-0.16) because this run samples three propagation levels (read / read+write / full) rather than a wider spread; the frozen gate is > 0.05 and 8/8 conditions exceed it with TOST power to spare (p_upper 5.6e-05).
Pooled r is -0.0258 here vs +0.046 in EXP-GRAPH-35353011131. Both are essentially zero relative to delta=0.15; the sign flip is sampling noise with no mechanism implying directional coupling.

Structural signal is a cardinality observable (body key count + semantic header count + status code). X-Request-Id/Date/Server/Content-Length/Connection excluded from fingerprints to keep within-state fingerprints stable.
Determinism strategy: single global RNG seeded at 42 before server thread start; server runs threaded=False and the client is sequential, so the sample sequence is reproducible from raw_evidence.

result_draft.json (driver-internal packet) contains the full per-sample evidence pointers; the public result.json carries canonical outcome SUPPORTS for the packet enum (SUPPORTS|FALSIFIES|MIXED|INCONCLUSIVE|NOT_APPLICABLE).
